newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian blue chips mixed, short-term gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Latvian blue chips mixed, short-term gains seen.

text.p: Blue chips were mixed in slow trade on Latvia's bourse on Thursday and dealers said short-term gains could be on the horizon as six-month results roll in.
Overall market volume was only 41,000 lats and the Rietumu index inched up 0.69 percent to 153.11. The bourse index rose 0.62 percent to 385.78.
Three of the market's five official list shares rose and two eased.

Offical list gainers included the Riga Transport Fleet, which added two santimes to 1.19 lats in light trade of 2,500 lats. Dealers expect it to gain further ahead of its six month results, which the market anticipates will be favourable.
Unibanka also rose, edging up one santime to 3.36 lats in trade of 13,700 lats.

Dealers say that if Unibanka maintains a steady rise it could help lift the rest of the market, which has suffered from summer-induced inactivity and competition from the local debt market and privatisation vouchers.

In the long-run, dealers say the market needs bigger companies and the participation of asset funds and other institutional investors to reach the levels of liquidity which have driven the bourse in neighbouring Estonia.
